items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: So Jesse Stone had did the arranging.

ctx.x: Now, he was a fine tenor player, but Bob -- I could do more with Bob, I guess, and Ben than anybody. They all liked me. They liked my style of playing. He had a peculiar way of playing, beautiful thing. He played, you know, interpretations. And one day we were rehearsing to go to the Apollo Theater. So they had (unintelligible) on bass. So Jesse Stone had did the arranging.
